evidence.observation: Growth-stage pressure 2.952 Torr, matching the ramp baseline of about 2.96 Torr
Pressure rose steadily to 3.159 Torr (+0.21 Torr in 600 s) while argon flow held at 100 sccm
Argon flow steady at 100.3 sccm, so the rise is not caused by more argon coming in
Thermocouple holding at 750.2 °C with steady heater power, so temperature control looks normal
Exhaust O2 sensor not installed; the growth atmosphere cannot be verified

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 or leak-check reading would tell a seal leak (air getting in, O2 rises) from an exhaust blockage (O2 stays low). A pump-line or exhaust valve check, or a rate-of-rise test with the argon flow stopped, would also separate them.
